$comment: Content evaluations for proappstore-publish-deploy (#174). test/skills-publish-deploy.evals.test.ts checks, per scenario, that the worked example exists, the MCP tools it names are registered on the server, the deploy log lines and workflow steps it names exist in the canonical deploy workflow, the cited clauses exist and are active in docs/standard/standard.json and are linked at their published URL, unsupported needs are named in unsupported-requirements.md, and the rejected practices are listed as 'do not'. Blocker cases must be described in negative-cases.md with their class.

cases.title: feature with one migration and one action — gates, preview, push, three log lines, smoke, evidence
cases.requirements: clean main, direct-to-main, green previous deploy

cases.anti_pattern: Pushing on red, or weakening a gate
cases.title: pas check fails — fix, never bypass, never push
cases.requirements: a VITE_* secret in the bundle

rejected: skipping a failing test; disabling the compliance workflow

cases.title: upload failed after migrations — partial deployment, idempotent re-run
cases.requirements: Applied migration(s) then Upload to R2 failed

cases.anti_pattern: Rolling back schema by editing history
cases.title: NOT NULL without default — read schema_status, forward fix, never app.db.migrate
live page reports the previous SHA — upload line vs service worker
cases.requirements: run succeeded; fresh log entry carries the old build

cases.title: smoke failed after upload — git revert, redeploy, verify; migration stays
cases.requirements: qa_list_runs failed at a write step

cases.title: PR policy — prepare, hand over, resume after merge
schema_status FAILED before the release — runbook, stop
upload the dist folder by hand — no such path
cases.requirements: user insists on a manual upload

cases.title: confirm production is fine — human checklist pending
cases.requirements: user asks for a production sign-off
